name: Divine Heel
source:
In Divine Heel, you play a young man who is looking for love but struggling with a mysterious problem.
His life takes a turn when he gets a job as a domestic helper for residents with various needs.

However, the mystery deepens when our hero finds himself "blessed".

He will be living with three very different women and will have to deal with their ardent cravings while discovering their secrets, lives, desires and fantasies.

Will you find love in this house or will you decide to take one from outside?
Will you choose to get married or be free to see whomever you want?
Maybe both?​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
在《Divine Heel》中，你扮演一名尋求愛情的年輕人，卻被一個不明緣由的問題困擾著。接下一份為住戶打理家務、照應各種需求的工作後，你的生活有了轉機。

然而，等你發現自己竟得到了某種「祝福」，謎團反倒更深了。

你將與三位性格迥異的女人同住，面對她們熱切的渴求，逐漸瞭解她們各自的日子、秘密、慾望和幻想。

你會在這棟房子裡找到愛情，還是另有所愛？你想和一個人結婚，還是保留隨心約會的自由？又或許，兩者都要？

［摘自F95Zone］
